expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: A night actually up at Gangtey rather than a day trip, timed for the crane festival in November.
expert.tip: Gangtey has no central heating in the cheaper lodges. Ask for a bukhari, the wood stove, and they will light it before you turn in.

summary: 9 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Gangtey, Punakha, Paro, with 8 nights, Breakfast and dinner each day and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing tour, the gangtey and the phobjikha valley, the black necked crane festival, the punakha sightseeing tour.
included: Included: 8 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Gangtey, Punakha, Paro with Breakfast and dinner each day; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing tour; the Gangtey and the Phobjikha valley; the Black necked crane festival; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
